entries.speaker: Girl's Voice
entries.en: Hello.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Have you made any progress toward[n]finding the boss?
Things are going well.
It's none of your business.
Shibuya's a big place.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...That's good to hear.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I take it that means no.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well... you aren't wrong about that.
entries.uk: Що ж... тут ти не помиляєшся.

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Hey, you two got some time?[n]I have a great job for you.
entries.uk: Агов, у вас двох є хвилинка?[n]Маю для вас класну роботу.

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: It's real easy. Guess you could call it[n]a delivery job.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems we didn't have to look very hard[n]in the end.
entries.uk: Схоже, довго шукати нам[n]зрештою не довелося.

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: You're high schoolers, yeah? Don't you[n]want something more than just your[n]allowances?
entries.uk: Ви ж старшокласники, так? Хіба[n]не хочеться чогось більшого, ніж[n]кишенькові гроші?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm... by delivery, do you mean that of[n]suspicious materials?
entries.uk: Хм... під доставкою ви маєте на увазі[n]доставку підозрілих речовин?

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: Heh, you're a funny girl.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So you won't answer me? Then I was[n]right...
entries.uk: Тобто відповідати не будете? Отже,[n]я мала рацію...

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: Eh?

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: What's up with you anyways? Why're[n]you asking all these questions, huh?
entries.uk: Та що з тобою таке? Чого це ти[n]ставиш стільки питань, га?

entries.en: Violence is not the answer.
I'll call the cops on you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: ...It was all a joke. Why would I get[n]worked up over some dumb kids?
entries.uk: ...Це був жарт. Чого б я мав[n]заводитися через якихось дурних дітлахів?

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: Anyways, I can't hang. Seeya!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: U-Um, if you don't want to deal with us,[n]we could always go see your boss[n]ourselves.
entries.uk: Е-е, якщо ви не хочете з нами мати[n]справу, ми можемо й самі[n]піти до вашого боса.

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: You're really gonna say that, knowing[n]who he is?
entries.uk: Ти справді таке кажеш, знаючи,[n]хто він?

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: Heh, no way I believe that.
entries.uk: Хех, ніколи в це не повірю.

entries.speaker: Suspiciously Sleazy Guy
entries.en: Well, I'm outta here. You guys are[n]annoying me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm pretty sure he's part of the mafia[n]we're looking for.
entries.uk: Я майже певна, що він із тієї мафії,[n]яку ми шукаємо.

entries.en: Let's go after him.
I'm amazed you figured it out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think we should get some proof[n]before we do that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I tried to trick him into saying something,[n]but he dodged all the traps I was laying[n]down.
entries.uk: Я намагалася його розговорити, але[n]він оминув усі пастки, які я[n]розставила.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't have any proof though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I tried to trick him into saying something,[n]but he dodged all the traps I was laying[n]down.
entries.uk: Я намагалася його розговорити, але[n]він оминув усі пастки, які я[n]розставила.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way... thanks for standing up[n]for me.
entries.uk: До речі... дякую, що заступився[n]за мене.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm going to go now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That boss seems tricky... It looks like[n]he taught his subordinates well, too.
entries.uk: Схоже, цей бос хитрий... І своїх[n]підлеглих він, видно, добре вишколив.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No wonder the police are having trouble[n]catching him.
entries.uk: Не дивно, що поліція не може[n]його впіймати.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyway, you have some serious guts.[n]You didn't back down at all against[n]that hooligan.
entries.uk: Хай там як, а сміливості тобі не бракує.[n]Ти анітрохи не відступив перед[n]тим хуліганом.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Though we still didn't end up with any[n]new information...
entries.uk: Хоча нової інформації ми так[n]і не здобули...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's stop here for today.
